format_row_tf: format a single row from a PyArrow table into TensorFlow tensors using TFFormatter
format_column_tf: format a single column from a PyArrow table into a consolidated TensorFlow tensor
format_batch_tf: format a batch from a PyArrow table into a dictionary of TensorFlow tensors
recursive_tensorize_tf: recursively convert a nested dictionary of data into TensorFlow tensors using map_nested
consolidate_tf_tensors: consolidate a list of TensorFlow tensors into a stacked or ragged tensor
